author: Xdaj
content: Result: Implemented all 6 M12 performance optimizations in 6 separate commits: (1) tile-based erosion kernel with WG shared memory for Laplacian — workgroup size 64→256, neighbor reads from shared tile; (2) flow accumulation tuning — recompute every 10 steps instead of every step, ~90% fewer GPU readbacks; (3) climate early convergence — RMS temperature check exits iteration loop early when stable; (4) chunked snapshot transfer — 5-chunk async reads for level 9+; (5) f16 snapshot compression — temperature/precip/wind stored as float16 at level 9+, halving storage; (6) 20-test perf regression suite. All 461 tests pass, tsc clean.
